jobs.name: normal
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. The first image is the existing game's STYLE reference only, do not include the human. The second image is the Shaula animation sheet EDIT TARGET. Keep Shaula GIANT, with two huge ivory-tipped claws, eight legs, a broad segmented body and long jointed tail with white star. Match the simple chunky top-down 2D pixel-art style of the game, not a detailed illustration. MODERATELY REDUCE DETAIL: broader armor plates, fewer tiny plate lines, remove all scratches/rivets/grain/dithering and fine highlights, use 2 or 3 flat shades per material, roughly 14-18 colors per form, hard square pixel clusters about 3 physical pixels across. Keep threatening adult proportions and the exact camera, animation poses and 6-column layout. Do not blur or shrink the creature. NO BLOOD, NO RED SPLASHES, NO RED DUST, NO RED LIQUID, NO POOLS, NO INJURIES, NO GORE. Red is allowed ONLY on intact crimson armor. Every spell, tail-loss effect and defeat effect uses WHITE / IVORY / PALE GOLD hard-edged magic pixels or DRY GRAY chips. Real alpha transparency, no ground, no checkerboard, no captions or grid. Keep this square sheet as exactly SIX rows and SIX columns, 36 frames, 1254x1254. All scorpions in this sheet have matte BLACK/charcoal armor, ivory claw edges and small white eye dots. Row1 idle, row2 walk, row3 claw grab, row4 ground slam, row5 tail laser charge/fire/recovery (white, not fire), row6 piercing sting and withdrawal. Use just tiny dry tan-gray dust at ground impacts. Preserve all complete limbs and action order, uniform body scale/pivot.
